business.description: Monind Limited did not generate any operating income during the financial year 2025-2026. The company is exploring appropriate opportunities and taking suitable measures to improve its business operations.

outlook.statement: The Board of Directors continues to monitor the business environment and remains committed to explore appropriate opportunities and take suitable measures to improve business operations.

The Company remains attentive to changes in the business environment and will evaluate suitable opportunities for resumption or expansion of its business activities, subject to market conditions and availability of resources.

The management continues to explore suitable business opportunities, strategic collaborations and investment avenues with the objective of identifying sustainable business activities and creating long-term value for the stakeholders.

auditor.name: M/s O P Bagla & Co LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.opinion: The report does not contain any qualification, reservation, or adverse remark
key_audit_matters: Old outstanding credit balances of Rs. 4,972.39 lacs under Trade Payables and Other financial liabilities in the financial statements.
qualifications_or_emphasis: Emphasis of Matter: Note no. 27 indicates no major business activities, accumulated losses resulting in erosion of net worth, net cash losses during the year and immediately preceding financial year, current liabilities exceeded current assets as at balance sheet date. These conditions may cast doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, financial statements prepared on going concern basis per management's perception.
The Company has incurred cash losses of Rs. 43.31 lakhs during the financial year under audit and Rs. 42.31 lakhs in the immediately preceding financial year.

Nothing has come to our attention, which causes us to believe that any material uncertainty exists as on the date of the audit report indicating that Company is not capable of meeting its liabilities existing at the date of balance sheet as and when they fall due within a period of one year from the balance sheet date. We, however, state that this is not an assurance as to the future viability of the Company.
Balance confirmations have not been received from some of the parties showing debit/credit balances.

The company has accounted for retirement benefit of employees on accrual basis calculated on arithmetical basis based on last drawn salaries which is considered sufficient by the management in view of significance of amount for compliance of Ind AS -19.

Deferred tax asset has not been recognized in terms of Ind- AS 12 issued by ICAI by adopting the conservative approach in respect of ascertained profitability in the future years for setting off the deferred tax asset.
Previous year figures have been regrouped wherever necessary.
